description: Change the display name, bio, whether the small "Made with stomp.to" badge shows, and whether visitors (and their AI) can subscribe by email or send the user messages. Also the page-wide settings: the search and sharing title and description, affiliate tags for book buttons, sending every visitor to one link (redirect, optionally between dates), a passcode that makes the page private, UTM tags on outgoing links, and a Meta Pixel or Google Analytics ID (loaded only for visitors who accept a cookie banner). Also the profile photo: from an https image link, or made with AI (restyle the current photo, or describe a new one). Omit fields to keep them; null turns a setting off.

aiPhoto.description: Make a new profile photo with AI and use it. Up to 6 a day; every result is checked to keep pages PG-13.

description.description: What the picture shows. Leave out to restyle the current profile photo instead.

allowMessages.description: Allow visitors and their AI to send the user messages by email.

allowSubscribe.description: Show the email sign-up on the page and allow visitors' AI to subscribe.

amazonTag.description: Amazon Associates tag (like name-20) added to book buttons' Amazon links. "" removes it.

avatarUrl.description: An https link to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF (up to 2 MB) to use as the profile photo. "" removes the photo.

bookshopId.description: Bookshop.org affiliate ID (a number) used for book buttons' Bookshop.org links. "" removes it.

googleAnalyticsId.description: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID, like G-AB12CD34EF. Loads only for visitors who accept the cookie banner. "" turns it off.

metaPixelId.description: Meta Pixel ID (a number). Visitors see a cookie banner and the pixel loads only if they accept. "" turns it off.

passcode.description: Make the page private: visitors type this passcode once per device. A new one replaces the old; null makes the page public again. Passcodes can't be read back.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

url.description: A web address (https://…), a bare domain, or an email address.

redirect.description: Send every visitor straight to this link, for a launch or campaign, optionally only between startsAt and endsAt. Search engines still see the page. null turns it off.

seoDescription.description: The description search engines and social apps show ("" uses the default).

seoTitle.description: The title search engines and social apps show for the page ("" uses the default).

utm.description: Add UTM tags to outgoing links when visitors tap them (for example source "stomp.to", medium "link_in_bio", campaign the handle). Links that already have UTM tags keep theirs. null turns it off.
